method: Local static server + Playwright headless Chromium driving the shipped index.html UI (search box + two-click grid equip), 1600x900 viewport. Same-origin assets, so canvas reads and element screenshots are untainted. Every measurement below is from the live running app, not Node unit tests.
fix: js/app.js and demo/app.js renderAvatar filtered draw calls with atlases.has(c.atlas); the pet leash string is a line primitive with no atlas, so it was dropped before drawCanvas.
